policyConfirmationRecovery.implementation: PendingPolicy retains original input, matching typed receipt and needsRefresh separately from uncertain. A matching receipt proves mutation committed; failed/malformed/foreign/unchanged confirmation retains old view and disables edits with needsRefresh=true, uncertain=false. Internal read returns failure directly instead of depending on React publication order. Public refresh/refreshEvents remain Promise<void>. retryPolicy with retained receipt performs GET only; request-outcome uncertainty without receipt still retries the exact original PUT body. No timers, polling, sends or new durable store.
policyConfirmationRecovery.consumer: Core must check pendingPolicy.needsRefresh before uncertain, render saved-but-needs-confirmation feedback plus policyError and an explicit Refresh sharing action. retryPolicy is a read-only recovery once pendingPolicy.receipt exists. Keep checkboxes bound to projection.view until authoritative reconciliation.
